One account

Customer when you need it. Provider when you’re working.

Create a Planifya account first. After your provider application is approved, provider capabilities are added to that same account—there is no separate provider login.

  • Create and manage service listings
  • Accept, decline and track booking requests
  • Send custom offers through Planifya chat
  • Create ticketed events subject to event verification
Application flow

Three steps to your provider tools.

The estimated provider application review target is about 2–3 business days. Incomplete information or follow-up checks can take longer.

1

Create your account

Sign up, verify your email and keep your name, phone and profile details accurate.

2

Submit business details

Add business name, address, category, business phone and the information requested by the application.

3

Receive provider access

After approval, switch into provider tools on the same account and create accurate service listings.

Founding vendor offer

The first 500 vendors join free.

No vendor subscription fee for the first 500 approved Planifya vendors.

FREE vendor subscription

Reserved for the first 500 approved vendors.

  • Provider dashboard and listing tools
  • Booking-request and custom-offer workflows
  • Event creation tools for approved providers

Transaction commissions still apply to completed sales. Offer eligibility is based on provider approval order and is subject to Planifya’s published terms.

Simple commission

You keep the price, minus commission.

Buyers pay the amount shown at checkout. Planifya deducts commission from provider or organizer proceeds, so customers are not shown a separate Planifya surcharge unless checkout explicitly says otherwise.

Service bookings
5%

On completed service bookings

Deducted from the provider-side amount. A PKR 10,000 completed booking means PKR 500 Planifya commission and PKR 9,500 provider net, before any applicable external deductions.

Ticket sales
2%

On ticket sales

Deducted from organizer proceeds. A PKR 2,000 ticket sale means PKR 40 Planifya commission and PKR 1,960 organizer net, before any applicable external deductions.

Current published platform configurationThese rates are effective from 3 August 2026. Rates may change for future transactions; the commission and net amount recorded for an existing transaction remain fixed for that transaction.
Verification

Approval and the badge are different.

Provider approval gives access to provider features. The verification badge is a separate identity and business-document review; it is not a guarantee of quality or future performance.

Every verification type

CNIC front and back, plus a utility bill. A portfolio URL is optional.

Registered business

The common documents plus a business-registration document.

Local vendor

The common documents plus shop photos. Clear, current and authentic evidence is required.

Protect your documents.Upload verification material only through the official Planifya flow. Never send CNIC images, passwords, OTPs, card PINs or CVVs to someone claiming to onboard you through social media.
Provider responsibilities

Accurate listings. Honest delivery.

Planifya can review, restrict or remove listings or accounts for safety, fraud, policy, intellectual-property or legal reasons.

List what you can deliver

Keep pricing, packages, features, location coverage, availability, media and exclusions accurate.

Keep agreements on record

Use Planifya chat and custom offers for scope, price, dates and terms. Do not ask customers to pay conflicting amounts off-platform.

Use the completion PIN properly

Request the customer’s six-digit PIN only after the service is actually complete. Never pressure a customer to share it early.
